title: Validate registered recording candidates and preservation rules
description: Assess a complete current-format recording candidate against closed record shape, registry/reference, and prior-state preservation rules. Distinguish mechanical admissibility from substantive adequacy so explicit corrections remain recordable.
inputs: Complete candidate manifest and registered supporting records under the explicit supported contract.
Coherent prior records when finding-ID, blocker-origin, or update-preservation rules apply.
outputs: A structurally admissible complete candidate or safe rule-specific rejection.
Separate factual observations of changed subjects, failed evidence, or inconsistent recorded claims without rewritten decisions.
behavior: Reject unknown record/field/vocabulary/version input, duplicate keys/IDs, invalid encoding and missing required values before dependent reference or preservation checks.

Validate every registered record's path, kind, change identity and explicit record-level applicability, and resolve field-specific EntryRefs against the final combined candidate with disjoint referenceable IDs.

Preserve complete immutable blocker origins; preserve existing Review finding IDs while permitting explicit valid correction of non-ID current fields and retaining full findings during assessment-only edits.

Apply the exact Review/Verify explanation and optional complete verification_basis shapes without parsing prose for decisions, requiring Git universally, or equating metadata with authentic authority.
Keep structural errors separate from observations of external subject drift, failed evidence and contradictory claims; do not gate a valid correction on stage eligibility or assessment adequacy.

failure_behavior.condition: A candidate contains an unknown/mixed contract, invalid shape/reference, or preservation violation.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject before publication with safe diagnostic context; do not normalize a retired record or guess a reference.

failure_behavior.condition: Engineering adequacy or reliance is unsettled despite a structurally valid candidate.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the supplied decision and distinct observation; do not fabricate approval or reject a correction solely to enforce workflow progression.
